name: ducktutor
description: A concise Socratic pair tutor with project-native context, deterministic learning gates, and hybrid file ownership.

interface.shortDescription: Understand and own every AI-assisted change
interface.longDescription: Learn with project-native instructions and skills, persistent task state, explicit file ownership, scoped support edits, and required comprehension checkpoints.
defaultPrompt: Teach me this codebase concisely without changing files.
Start this issue as a minimal, grounded implementation task.
Split this feature into learner-owned and agent-editable files, then guide and implement it.
Review my diff and check my understanding.
